summary: A switch for an on/off setting, with its label, description and error laid out beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the track and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps external <label for> from reaching the inner input.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when the row has other visible text naming the setting.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid and sets a customError validity.

value.note: Submitted with the form while on.

checked.note: Current state (on). Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

size.note: default: 32x20px track, 16px thumb. sm: 24x16px track, 12px thumb.

required.note: Native required: the switch must be on to submit. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Native disabled; dimmed; not submitted. Also true when a disabled fieldset contains the switch.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: track in the first column, label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Track wrapper; the native input fills it and the thumb is drawn over it.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">, drawn as the track; receives focus, Space and validation.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: The sliding knob. Decorative, aria-hidden, ignores pointer events; moves to the inline end when on (mirrored in RTL).

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl).

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring and border in ring color (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track takes the primary fill and the thumb moves to the inline end. State is carried by position as well as color (WCAG 1.4.1).

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or a disabled ancestor fieldset

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: ElementInternals via FormAssociated: setFormValue(value) only while on (nothing submitted when off), validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing), formResetCallback restores the default checked state from the checked attribute, formDisabledCallback follows a disabled fieldset, disabled is not submitted, error sets a customError validity.

accessibility.targetSize: Track is 32x20px (default) or 24x16px (sm); the label is part of the clickable row and the 12px gap satisfies the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception for sm.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009). It does not toggle.

aria: role="switch" on the native checkbox; aria-checked is exposed from the native checked state
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)
toggle is announced by the switch role as on/off; no extra live text

useCases.when: A setting that is on or off and takes effect as soon as it is flipped
An on/off preference inside a form that submits a value
The consequence of the setting needs explaining
A setting must be on before the form can submit
useCases.use: required with a label that states what is enabled

antiPatterns.pattern: A choice that is only recorded when the form is submitted, such as consent or terms
antiPatterns.why: A switch implies immediate effect; a checkbox records a choice
A switch has two states only

antiPatterns.pattern: A button-like pressed action in a toolbar
antiPatterns.why: A switch is a form control with a label, not a pressed button
The label is the only name for the switch
antiPatterns.alternative: A label that states the setting

coverage: label is the name; label click toggles; role is switch
Space toggles; Enter does not toggle; keyboard focus ring
default and sm sizes: track and thumb dimensions
checked changes the track paint and moves the thumb (mirrored in RTL)
description and error in the accessible description; aria-invalid
required: native required, aria-hidden asterisk, invalid after blur
input and change composed, once per toggle
form: value submitted only while on, custom value, nothing when off, reset to the attribute default, validity (required -> valueMissing), disabled fieldset, error customError

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn default unchecked track is bg-input (neutral-200); changed for WCAG 1.4.11
not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset
shadcn's Switch has no required handling beyond Radix's

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: APG switch pattern (role=switch, Space toggles), label row beside the track.

openQuestions.question: Native <input type=checkbox role=switch> or a custom element with ARIA?
openQuestions.answer: Native input with role=switch (SB-0007: native first). Focus, Space, validity and required come for free.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: No, same as Checkbox. The attribute is the default that form reset restores; checked is a property and the attribute is read at start.

openQuestions.question: Is label required?
openQuestions.answer: Yes, like Checkbox and Input. hide-label keeps it as the accessible name.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes, and what are they called?
openQuestions.answer: Two: default and sm (values default | sm, like Native Select), mapped to the API size vocabulary.

openQuestions.question: What does a switch submit when off?
openQuestions.answer: Nothing, like a native checkbox. When on it submits value (default "on").

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle or submit?
openQuestions.answer: Enter submits the form (SB-0009, same as Checkbox); only Space toggles. APG leaves Enter optional for switch.

openQuestions.question: What does required mean for a switch?
openQuestions.answer: It must be on to submit (native checkbox valueMissing), matching Checkbox.

openQuestions.question: Is there an indeterminate state or a loading state?
openQuestions.answer: No. Two states only; a switch with pending work is the host app's concern.
